summary: Validated CEP autofill bug fix on /inscricao.html. Backend GET /api/cep/{cep} returns 200 and frontend now correctly consumes it with no CSP violations. Address fields are auto-filled on blur.
critical_code_review_comments: CEP_STATUS uses transient text (auto-clears after 2s on success) — acceptable, but ensure screen-reader / accessibility feedback if required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CEP flow verified: valid CEP 66060-300 -> GET /api/cep/66060300 200, fields LOGRADOURO=PASSAGEM LIZETE, BAIRRO=FÁTIMA, CIDADE=BELÉM, UF=PA. Invalid CEP 00000-000 -> status 'CEP não encontrado — preencha manualmente'. No CSP violations captured in console. Success status 'Endereço encontrado' fades out after ~2s by design.
rca of the issue: Original bug: meta CSP had default-src 'none' with no connect-src directive, causing fetch('/api/cep/...') to be blocked and JS to fall into the catch branch showing 'Erro ao buscar CEP'. Fix: add connect-src 'self' to CSP meta tag on inscricao.html. Verified: fetch now succeeds (200), address fields autofilled, no CSP violations in browser console.
